quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Premier North American aggregates infrastructure franchise protected by captive local quarry monopolies and ~25-mile trucking radius barriers. Physical operating ROIC of 17.73% preserved (tangible capital return, neutralizing $5.27B acquisition goodwill). Peak Owner EPS of $8.65 in FY2025 reflects uninterrupted cash gross profit per ton compounding ($11.33/ton, +6.8% YoY) with zero cyclical windfall. 5-10Y secular growth of 8.0% anchored by 1.5% aggregates volume, 4.5% pricing power, 1.0% unit margin expansion, and 1.0% buybacks/bolt-ons. Disciplined balance sheet with net debt of $4.18B (3.88x NI, 2.0x EBITDA), 6.76x EBIT interest coverage, and 89.4% FCF conversion.
